name: disk-hygiene
description: Session-owned disk cleanup for Codex and Claude Code: registered git worktrees and their local branches are removed once the linked PR head contains every local commit, and ended-session runtime files are purged. Rollouts are kept unless deletion is explicitly enabled.

interface.shortDescription: Remove finished worktrees and runtime files your session owns
interface.longDescription: Registered git worktrees and their local branches are removed after the linked PR head contains every local commit. Runtime files of ended sessions are purged. Transcripts are kept by default; DISK_HYGIENE_CLEANUP=off disables everything.
